reason: I'd maybe poke at the free plan after that near-miss with the client, but I've already sunk years into my Notion setup and I'd rather rebuild it one more time than move everything into another app.
objection: All-in-one apps are mediocre at everything. I'd still keep my real email client open, so this becomes a fifth app instead of replacing four.
would_change_my_mind: If it could import my Notion client pages and the email side was genuinely good enough to drop my mail client, so the follow-up reminders actually live where I read mail.
